"'''Chapter 3: Whispers in the Unknown'''" is the third episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]'' and will be released on [[April 13]], [[2026]] alongside "[[Chapter 4: Pride and Vengeance]]". Its title was revealed on [[March 17]], [[2026]] by the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' Twitter account.<ref name="Twitter" />
